verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's own docs describe an official MCP server that gives AI assistants and agents programmatic access to its Admin/Management API, and a probe confirms the dedicated documentation page exists. Through it, an assistant can manage feature flags, segments, multivariate options and release workflows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and documented setup details (transport, authentication, client configuration).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Flagsmith MCP Server gives AI assistants and agents programmatic access to the Flagsmith Admin API through the Model Context Protocol
Your assistant can manage feature flags, segments, multivariate options, and release workflows on your behalf
